title: Larry Wall Speaks at Google
summary: Larry Wall speaks at Google's Chicago office in 2008 about the Perl community, the language, and Perl 6. The talk touches on grammars, macros and error messages.
why: HN mentions it for its Perl 6 content, though some note the delivery is less lively than Wall's usual talks.

quote.text: here's a Google Tech Talk from last year, which is nowhere near as funny as Larry usually is, but is still quite informative
